page_title: CZE 0-3 MEX | Czech Republic v Mexico 25/06/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The match has just finished.
90+4' 0 - 3 Alvaro Fidalgo (Mexico) receives a precise pass inside the box from Roberto Alvarado and he beats the goalkeeper with a neat finish into the left side of the net. 0:3.

90+4' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Santiago Gimenez (Mexico) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot low towards the middle of the goal, but Matej Kovar pulls off a comfortable save.
90+3' A lofted pass into the box is met by David Doudera (Czech Republic), who rifles a shot just over the bar.
90+2' Referee Yael Perez sees the trip by Obed Vargas (Mexico) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
90+2' Vladimir Coufal (Czech Republic) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
90+2' Pavel Sulc (Czech Republic) fires a powerful shot which is blocked.
90' We will have 6 min. of added time.
87' Miroslav Koubek is forced to make a change. Tomas Soucek (Czech Republic) is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Alexandr Sojka.
87' Substitution. Lukas Cerv did his best and is replaced by Tomas Chory (Czech Republic).
84' It doesn’t look good for Tomas Soucek (Czech Republic); looks like he’ll have to leave the pitch!
82' Michal Sadilek (Czech Republic) crosses the ball into the box from the free kick, but the defence clears the danger.
82' It looks like Jorge Sanchez (Mexico) saw red with that tackle. Yael Perez won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul. Czech Republic will take a free kick near the side line.
81' David Doudera (Czech Republic) tries his luck with a shot, but his effort goes wide of the target.
79' The corner from Roberto Alvarado (Mexico) is hurriedly cleared.
79' Julian Quinones (Mexico) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger. Corner kick. Mexico will have an opportunity.
78' Javier Aguirre has decided to substitute Mateo Chavez Garcia and he is replaced by Jesus Gallardo (Mexico).
78' That's the end of the game for Raul Rangel, who is replaced by Guillermo Ochoa (Mexico).

77' Julian Quinones (Mexico) missed a great opportunity! He finds himself some space near the penalty spot and plants a header goalwards which lacks both power and accuracy. The ball sails well over the bar!
76' Michal Sadilek (Czech Republic) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
76' Michal Sadilek (Czech Republic) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.
75' The attendance is 80824.
74' Rough tackle by Robin Hranac (Czech Republic). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
73' Michal Sadilek (Czech Republic) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
73' Vladimir Coufal (Czech Republic) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
72' It will be a substitution. Alvaro Fidalgo (Mexico) is ready to enter the pitch as Gilberto Mora walks off.
68' It’s time for the cooling break for the players to take on some fluids. It’s hot out there!
68' A rebound falls kindly for David Doudera (Czech Republic), but his shot from the edge of the box flies high over bar. None too pretty!
68' Vladimir Coufal (Czech Republic) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
67' Michal Sadilek (Czech Republic) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.
67' A cross into the box from Robin Hranac (Czech Republic) is cleared. The ball goes out of play and Czech Republic have been awarded a corner kick.
66' The corner is swung in but Czech Republic can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
64' Here is a change. Tomas Holes is going off and Miroslav Koubek gives the last tactical orders to Tomas Soucek (Czech Republic).
64' Substitution. Adam Hlozek makes way for Patrik Schick (Czech Republic).
64' Yael Perez shows a yellow card to Edson Alvarez (Mexico), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
63' Substitution. Luis Romo walks off the pitch and Obed Vargas (Mexico) comes on as a substitute.
63' Javier Aguirre prepares a substitution. Guillermo Martinez Ayala is replaced by Santiago Gimenez (Mexico).
61' 0 - 2 Goal! A mistake from the defence gifted a chance to a lurking Julian Quinones (Mexico), who keeps his cool and rolls the ball into the net from close range. 0:2.
61' Vladimir Coufal (Czech Republic) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
61' Michal Sadilek (Czech Republic) hammers the ball from far out, but his shot is blocked by an opposition player.
57' Gilberto Mora (Mexico) sends in a cross from a long-range free kick. However, his effort lacks accuracy and the ball sails off the pitch.
57' Lukas Provod (Czech Republic) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Yael Perez blows his whistle for a foul. Mexico have a free kick.
56' The referee signals a substitution. Lukas Provod (Czech Republic) is brought on as a substitute for Denis Visinsky.

55' 0 - 1 An amazing individual effort from Mateo Chavez Garcia (Mexico) ends with a strike from inside the penalty area. He sends the ball precisely into the bottom left corner and makes it 0:1. Matej Kovar was helpless.
54' Michal Sadilek (Czech Republic) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates as he overhits the effort.
53' Lukas Cerv (Czech Republic) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. Now Czech Republic have a corner.
53' The free kick is delivered by Vladimir Coufal (Czech Republic) but it's not one of his best and is easily cleared.
52' Luis Romo (Mexico) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.

46' Raul Rangel blocks Lukas Cerv (Czech Republic)'s effort from the edge of the box.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+5' Yael Perez has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+3' Tomas Holes (Czech Republic) is penalised for holding. Yael Perez signals a set piece.
45+3' Unlucky! A great strike from Julian Quinones (Mexico) near the edge of the box had the keeper scrambling but flew just over the bar.
45+1' Michal Sadilek (Czech Republic) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
45' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
45' Michal Sadilek (Czech Republic) is being forced to leave the pitch in order to receive medical treatment and his team will play with a man short for a few minutes.
44' The keeper doesn't have to worry about this one. David Doudera (Czech Republic) sacrificed accuracy for power, and thus his attempt went well wide of the right post.
44' The free kick is taken by Vladimir Coufal (Czech Republic), but ball is cleared.
43' Yael Perez couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Guillermo Martinez Ayala (Mexico) and blew his whistle. Czech Republic are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
43' Michal Sadilek (Czech Republic) takes the free kick from a long way out but the defender manages to get it clear.
42' Cesar Montes (Mexico) tackles a bit over-zealously and Yael Perez blows for a foul. Czech Republic have been awarded a free kick from long distance, it won't be a direct shot.
39' Roberto Alvarado (Mexico) latches onto the ball in the penalty box and takes a first-time effort that goes a couple of yards over the crossbar.

39' This was a piece of cake for Matej Kovar. Jorge Sanchez (Mexico) found himself some space after latching on to a pass, but his strike only went towards the middle of the goal and into the gloves of the prepared keeper.
39' Gilberto Mora (Mexico) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
37' Israel Reyes (Mexico) tries an acrobatic volley inside the box that disappears way past the left post.
37' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Mexico, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
36' Lukas Cerv (Czech Republic) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Mexico will take a free kick.
34' Roberto Alvarado (Mexico) sends a cross into the box, but Matej Kovar comes off his line to gather the ball.
32' Vladimir Coufal (Czech Republic) found some space to play in a lofted pass, but he looks disappointed as none of his teammates managed to connect with it.
30' The cross into the penalty area from David Doudera (Czech Republic) needed to be more accurate in order to create a goal-scoring opportunity for his team.
27' Denis Visinsky (Czech Republic) tries his luck and takes a shot from inside the box. His effort on goal is blocked by a defender.
26' Yael Perez blows his whistle for a foul after Guillermo Martinez Ayala (Mexico) hacks down one of his opponents.
26' Jorge Sanchez (Mexico) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
22' It’s hot out there so the ref signals there will be a cooling break for the players to take on some fluids.
22' Roberto Alvarado (Mexico) delivers a poor cross from a free kick as one of the defenders comfortably clears it away.
21' Robin Hranac (Czech Republic) makes an unfair challenge by holding his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball. Mexico are awarded the free kick.
18' Gilberto Mora (Mexico) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
17' The foul by Adam Hlozek (Czech Republic) was seen by Yael Perez who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
16' The game is interrupted, a clear handball by Luis Romo (Mexico).
15' Denis Visinsky (Czech Republic) unleashes a shot, but it's well wide of the right-hand post.
14' Mateo Chavez Garcia (Mexico) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
12' Michal Sadilek (Czech Republic) unleashes a first-time shot which goes well wide of the left post. Next time he should aim better. What a poor effort!
12' Vladimir Coufal (Czech Republic) sends the ball into the penalty area from a throw-in as if it's a corner kick.
11' Guillermo Martinez Ayala (Mexico) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
11' Roberto Alvarado (Mexico) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging.
10' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Guillermo Martinez Ayala (Mexico), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
8' Denis Visinsky (Czech Republic) misses a great opportunity from inside the penalty area after blasting the ball towards goal and it goes wide of the left post.
5' Vladimir Coufal (Czech Republic) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee immediately stops play.
4' Mateo Chavez Garcia (Mexico) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
4' Jorge Sanchez (Mexico) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
1' Guillermo Martinez Ayala (Mexico) was too forceful with his tackle and Yael Perez interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
